member.name: T:bolt.module.package.compile.ArgumentLineBuilder
member.summary: Builds a Windows command-line argument string from a list of individual args, following the standard CommandLineToArgvW parsing rules: wraps an arg in double quotes when it contains space/tab/quote, escapes any internal double quote as \", and doubles every run of backslashes that immediately precedes a double quote (including the closing one). The backslash-doubling step is required: without it, an arg like C:\dir\ quotes to "C:\dir\" — the closing " gets consumed as an escape and the next arg silently glues onto this one.

member.name: M:bolt.module.package.compile.ArgumentLineBuilder.Quote(System.String)
member.summary: Encodes a single arg using CommandLineToArgvW round-trip rules: - 2N backslashes followed by " decode to N backslashes and a literal quote. - Trailing backslashes before the closing quote are similarly doubled. - Backslashes not adjacent to a quote pass through unchanged.

member.name: T:bolt.module.package.compile.AuthenticodeVerifier
member.summary: SDL BIN-1: per-execution Authenticode verification for the X++ SDK binaries this module invokes (xppc.exe, LabelC.exe, xppbp.exe). The first invocation of a given path in the process performs a full Authenticode check via WinVerifyTrust (signature, chain, revocation) AND a publisher check requiring O=Microsoft Corporation in the signer subject. The result is cached for the lifetime of the process so subsequent invocations of the same path pay no cost. A verification failure throws and aborts the spawn — the SDK is considered untrusted and the build cannot continue.

member.name: T:bolt.module.package.compile.AuthenticodeVerifier.SafeNativeMethods
member.summary: P/Invokes are grouped under a class named SafeNativeMethods per CA1060 / the .NET Framework Design Guidelines. Each P/Invoke pins the search path to System32 via per CA5392 to block search-path-based DLL hijacking attacks (e.g. a malicious wintrust.dll dropped into the current directory).
